subject.description: The form's subject line. Optional: the public form does not require it.

replyBody.description: The reply text. Recording only — the system does not send it.

topic.description: What the story is about; null for an article nobody has classified yet.

tags.description: Free labels, as the newsroom typed them. The badge a reader sees and the value a tag link carries are the same string.

publishDate.description: ISO date this article went live; null while it never has.

sourceOutlet.description: Who published the story first. Non-null only on a `FederationInMedia` round-up, and null on the rows written before the field existed.

sourceUrl.description: The original article's address, for the external link beside the attribution.

coverMediaId.description: ref → mediaAssets; the reader resolves it through the media route.

excerpt.description: The opening of each language, plain. Derived rather than stored: a second field for the summary is a second thing to keep true, and the card and the meta description both want this.

category.description: Which shelf of the newsroom this belongs on. Not `externalMediaCoverage`, which is a separate collection of links to coverage published elsewhere — this labels an article the federation wrote itself. Omitted means General.

topic.description: What the story is about. Required on a new article; articles written before the field existed have none. Not `category` (the shelf) and not `tags` (free words).

sourceOutlet.description: Who published the story first. REQUIRED when `category` is `FederationInMedia` — that category means the federation is reporting somebody else's coverage, and the outlet is what makes it one. Never asked of a `General` article.

sourceUrl.description: The original article's address, `http(s)` only. REQUIRED when `category` is `FederationInMedia`, alongside `sourceOutlet`. Never asked of a `General` article.

tags.description: Free labels for display and filtering. NOT a second category: `category` is a closed list of one, and it decides which homepage section the article appears in.

slug.description: URL segment, shared by both language editions of the story.

coverMediaId.description: ref → mediaAssets, must be an image.

body.description: The article body, one document per language.

authorDisplayName.description: The byline readers see. May differ from the account that wrote the article.

seo.description: Overrides for the page title, description and share image. Absent means fall back to the headline.

topic.description: Changes the topic. Cannot be cleared.

sourceOutlet.description: Who published the story first. Required when this patch sets `category` to `FederationInMedia`. Null clears it.

sourceUrl.description: The original article's `http(s)` address. Required when this patch sets `category` to `FederationInMedia`. Null clears it.

tags.description: Free labels for display and filtering. NOT a second category: `category` is a closed list of one, and it decides which homepage section the article appears in.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: The `updatedAt` the editor was looking at. Publishing a record someone else edited in the meantime publishes an edit nobody chose to publish, so the server compares before freezing.

archived.description: True hides a published article from the feed; false returns it. The article stays published either way and keeps its URL — this is visibility, not retraction.

href.description: A public site path, never an API route.

total.description: Total matches for this source, independent of how many are returned.
